svg.text: Designed for use · clamshell, the panel is the lid
Opens like a theodolite case: plain outside, the reveal is the event.
Lid swings back to a hard stop at 15°, a fold-out leg takes the knob pressure.
Keys in the base (25 lever keys, silent, Hall-sensed). Speaker in the lid, far right.
Look shown: Field — warm-grey felt + cork stack, black panel, gold rules, orange cutoff
Hand-lettered legends, wordmark and grille are PLACEHOLDERS — the owner draws or paints the real ones.
PLAYING — top view, real proportions (1 mm = 7 px)
Hard stop at 165° + fold-out leg: one playing angle, no friction
hinge to creep. Pressing knobs pushes into the stop and the leg.
Low caps (hero 14 mm, others 13 mm) keep the knob pocket at
18 mm instead of 24 — about 6 mm thinner closed.
LIGHTS OFF — glow pointers + sharp fronts
